purpose: Recognize records from different sources as the same underlying real-world entity without losing provenance or crossing company boundaries.
constitutional_rules: `company_id` is the sole canonical tenant/company boundary; entity matching never crosses it.
Source identifiers remain provenance-bearing aliases; normalization never destroys source identity.
Strong identifiers may resolve identity automatically only when non-conflicting and entity-type compatible.
Names, labels, URLs and descriptive similarity alone are insufficient for irreversible automatic merges.
Ambiguous or conflicting candidates remain unresolved and are surfaced explicitly.
Merge and split operations preserve lineage; canonical history is append-oriented, not destructive.
Entity normalization identifies sameness; it grants no permission, authority, ownership or execution rights.
Evidence references can support matching but the resolver must not rewrite source evidence.
pipeline: resolve or create provisional canonical entity
preserve source links and match evidence
